description: This file defines a Django middleware class that attaches a unique request ID to each incoming HTTP request. It reads the request header 'X-Request-ID' if present, generates a UUID4 if not, and makes this ID available for downstream logging and response headers.

classes.name: RequestIDMiddleware
classes.description: A Django middleware class that assigns a request ID to each HTTP request for tracing and correlation purposes.

methods.name: process_request(self, request)
methods.description: Reads the 'X-Request-ID' header from incoming requests and assigns a UUID if missing. Stores the request ID in request attributes and META.

methods.name: __call__(self, request, get_response: Callable = None)
methods.description: Handles the middleware processing by setting the request ID, invoking the next response handler, and attaching the request ID to the response headers.
